description: This file contains classes for logging options in the Orleans framework, specifically implementing a client options logger and a base options logger class that uses dependency injection and formatting to log configuration options.

classes.name: ClientOptionsLogger
classes.description: Logger for client options that participates in the cluster client lifecycle and logs options on startup.

classes.name: OptionsLogger
classes.description: Abstract base class providing functionality to log configuration options using registered formatters.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the logger to the cluster client lifecycle to trigger logging during the start phase.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Logs the options when the client lifecycle starts.

methods.name: LogOptions
methods.description: Logs options using a provided set of formatters.

methods.name: LogOption
methods.description: Logs options for a specific formatter, with error handling.
